acceptanceCriteria: make ci-least-privilege-check (or its CI step) passes on origin/main
Each added exception row names the job, permission and justification
body: Observed by lane ci-waste-1021g on base 8def072e0 (build 702): the ci-least-privilege-check gate fails on main because the narrowing-verdict and ci-forward-bar workflow permissions have no matching exception rows. Expected: either the permissions are narrowed or reviewed exception rows are recorded, and the check passes on main. Touches .github (owner ci-control-plane process).
title: ci-least-privilege-check fails on main: narrowing-verdict and ci-forward-bar permissions have no exception rows
